description: This source file defines the CustomerOption entity class used within the SalesManager e-commerce platform. It models customer options with properties such as code, type, active status, and associated descriptions. The class integrates with JPA/Hibernate for ORM and includes annotations for persistence schema, constraints, and relationships with other entities.

classes.name: CustomerOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer option, including attributes like code, type, order, activity status, and associated descriptions; linked to a MerchantStore and stored in the CUSTOMER_OPTION table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the customer option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the set of descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for easier ordering or display.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts the set of descriptions into a list, initializes if empty.

methods.name: getCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the customer option.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type/category of the customer option.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the unique code identifying this customer option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for this customer option.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the customer option is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the customer option.

methods.name: isPublicOption
methods.description: Returns whether the option is public.

methods.name: setPublicOption
methods.description: Sets whether the option is public.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the display sort order of the customer option.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display sort order of the customer option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this customer option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this customer option.
